observations: The first video action failed with OutputVideoSensitiveContentDetected.PolicyViolation before video bytes existed.
The identity continuity entity was backed by a 1x1 placeholder PNG, so it could not provide meaningful visual identity evidence.

The retained 2848x1600 JPEG is byte-backed and SHA-256 verified. It visibly contains a photorealistic adult male, a public crowd, an urban-plaza setting, a vivid red scarf and a watermark-like mark at bottom right.
The retained image does not visually preserve the declared daylight-beach setting.
causalityBoundary: The retained evidence does not identify which feature caused the provider policy decision. The visible features are diagnostic risk signals, not a claimed root cause, and the preflight cannot guarantee provider acceptance.

localFix.behavior: Fail closed before any paid action unless the candidate has a byte-backed identity reference of at least 256x256 with SHA-256, owned-or-licensed rights, a fictional adult performer, no public figures, no brands, and per-shot controlled-studio/unbranded constraints.

finiteSafeTestCreative.intent: A fictional adult performer handles an unbranded blue cloth in a controlled studio.
shots: fictional adult performer notices an unbranded blue cloth in a controlled studio
fictional adult performer folds the unbranded blue cloth in a controlled studio
fictional adult performer places the unbranded blue cloth down in a controlled studio
constraints: Use an owned or licensed, byte-backed fictional-performer reference; never use a placeholder.
No celebrity, public-figure, brand, franchise, artist-style, watermark, crowd or public-location request.
Keep the action ordinary and non-hazardous while preserving identity/performance observability.
Treat any future provider action as a new gated job; never retry or replay the source job.

decision: The consumed cp44 gate is closed with a local diagnosis and fail-closed preflight. T11 remains in progress; no future paid acceptance is authorized by this artifact.
